text: A girlfriend broke up with this guy and now he doesn't know what to do. Hello, maybe you won't read this but I got a question. My girlfriend of some time just broke up with me and she won't tell me why. She just says that we have too much stress in the last time so naturally I wonder was I not good enough for her. Did I make jokes with her that make her uncomfortable? But then I noticed today in school that she's chilling with people I hate the most at school because they told some s**t about me that wasn't true. They ghosted her about half a year ago because we were together and now I think they made an ultimatum I guess that she could choose them or me and she chose them. Or it could be that I pointed out that she only reposted s**t like how I would suck Sukuna's d**k, an anime character, and multiple vids of such stuff. Now I don't know. Sorry for bad English. Hope you could help me with this. Okay man, first of all learn how to write properly. Then find a video on my channel called How to Forget Your Ex and try to follow all the steps there. Maybe someone can help locate it in the comments. It is an old video though. Maybe I should make a newer version. Second, were you not good enough for her? Well yeah, if she breaks up with you she is basically telling you that you were not enough for her. But you see, instead of your reaction being I need to ask her what I did wrong and if I change it she will come back to me, your reaction should be the opposite. I am not enough for her? She is not enough for me. I deserve someone better next to me. And of course you need to be working on yourself to actually become that version of yourself that is too good for her. Also your thinking should be that you dodged a bullet, that if she went back to people who ghosted her, then that also showed you what kind of person she is. Overall, your approach should be this. At this point she is nobody to you. Block her everywhere and limit any contact with her. If you still have to see her because of classes, just be civil. But try not to even speak to her. If she says hi, just say hi and leave. If she asks you something, say that you're busy and you have to go. I get that it might be difficult to control your emotions, but you can't control your actions. And the more self-control you have, the better version of yourself you can become. Most importantly, you need to have activities in your life that distract you. Sports, hobbies, a new friend group, parties, social events. And of course the main thing, go meet other women. Use dating apps or meet them in real life. That is the best remedy in a situation like this. Hope this helps. My name is Ilyas Abdullin. Thank you and ciao.
